decision: Driver: Reprimand (Driving). This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season.
fact: The driver failed to follow Race Directors instruction for entry to the pit lane.
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code and non-compliance with Race Director's Event Note (item 8.4, document 8).
penalty: Driver: Reprimand (Driving). This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Prior to entering the Pit Lane, in the Pit Entry Road, the driver crossed the white line on the left. This is contrary to the Race Director's instruction.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 6 Crossing The White Line At Pit Entry
